column1: # The February 1862 filling of the War Department code, as far as William Echols (issue #352, 9 Nov 2026) derived it by matching ledger telegrams to their printed texts in the Official Records, series I, vol. VII (the printed pages are the contributor's references and were not checked here). The code words are refilled for each issue (see NOTES.md), so these values are for the traffic of Feb 1862 only; the project checked them for consistency against its own transcription of mssEC 15 (see NOTES.md).
